reviews.x: Returning. If you like your hair being torn out of your body, these are the blades for you.
Does not fit the Phillips one blade and does not cut hair. It only pulls hair out. Do not buy.

reviews.t: Absolute scam! Avoid this at all costs. I wouldn’t use these blades if someone paid me.
reviews.x: Pulled hair. Didn’t cut. Cheaply made. Scam.

They may look like the originals but don’t be fooled.  They wouldn’t make it through a 5 o’clock shadow. I had more hairs pulled out of my face then actually cut.  Terrible product all around.  Buyer beware.

reviews.t: NIOT A GOOD ALTERNATIVE PRODUCT FOR ONE BLADE
reviews.x: THE BLADE DOES NOT CUT EVENLY AND PULLS ON HAIR INSTEAD OF CUT IT. TRIED GOING VERY SLOW HOPING THAT IT WOULOD CUT WITHOUT CATCHING AND PULLING FACIAL HAIR. THIS WAS ON VERY SHORT FACIAL STUBBLE, NOT THICK HAIR. I PURCHASED THE 3 PACK AND ONLY USED ONE, ONE TIME. IT WAS NOT A GOOD EXPERIENCE.
Worst purchase I’ve ever made.  Nothing like the Phillips replacements.

reviews.t: It chops and pulls, not shave!
reviews.x: Seemed like a good deal but they suck. They don't come close to the original at all. Pay the extra $10 for the brand name replacements.

so i tried these and so far after using 2 out of the three blades have been a not so great of a experience. the blades would rip and pull at my hair right out the package. these blades also took a lot longer to complete a simple trim or shave. Ive been looking for the original brands and types but have been unsuccessful so far.  Unless really need these id suggest using a different brand.

To put it simply this is absolutely the worst grooming product I have ever purchased. The razors do not Fit very well into into my device. The razors get jammed up with hair extremely fast and it is difficult to get the jammed hair out. I didn't even finish shaving with them because it was so inconvenient. Ended up using clippers and a razor instead. Terrible product.

reviews.t: This product is not compatible with the one blade.
reviews.x: The blades did not click in and attach.  They fall out during use.  As well as the blades not being as sharp and pulling hair out and not making a clean cut.  The heads also fail to pivot anywhere near like the brand name version.  Do not waste your time trying to save a few dollars.  I'm returning the product It's terrible in every way.

Blades are horrible.  I found a hair on one blade and am convinced these may have been used and reconditioned.  I used one, found the hair on the second, and threw them all in the trash.  I was afraid to return them in case they might get repackaged and resold.  Poor quality, and distusting.

The blade fits the Philips OneBlade body, but the razor’s adjustable guard *cannot be attached*. These blades are *too tall*. The guard is prevented from fully seating and clipping in to the razor’s body as the photo shows.  By these only if you use the razor without the guard.

These were the biggest and worst mistake purchasing from Amazon ever. They were $6 less than the original blades.  The pulled at my 2 day old beard.  Nicked me once (bleeding).  I will never buy a replacement blade again other than the original.  Complete waste of money!

This blade does not feel like the original one blades. I’m not sure if the did not use the same coating or what, but it feels like daggers digging into my skin. Not the gentle glide I had with the original blades. Also it doesn’t lock into place

I needed replacement razors for my shaver / decided to go with the knock off cheaper option - huge mistake.  These razors are terrible every stroke feels like every single hair is being pulled out of my face.  Save your money and your face.

reviews.t: Your Face Deserves Better. MUCH Better.
reviews.x: These ‘blades’ are shoddy third party knock-offs of the real article. Each blade in the pack felt like it was ripping hair out of my face. Hard pass for anyone who wants to be able to look at their face in the mirror without feeling guilty.

These replacement “blades” do not cut the hair, rather rip them out of your skin.  Save yourself time & pain and buy the real Phillips Norelco blades.  I returned these.  It’s a sham product.  Amazon should remove from their platform.

Brand new blades out of the package snag and pull.  Blade guards do not sit properly on these blades and guards fall off.  Not a good purchase. I'd return but I already threw away original packaging believing they would work.

reviews.t: Pinches your skin and grabs hair!
reviews.x: Bought these because it said compatible with oneblade. Turns out, it does fit in the oneblade but definitely does NOT work like a oneblade. Pinched my skin and grabbed my hair which resulted in a huge gash on my neck.

These blades are horrible compared to the original blades.  The blade often pulls the hair as opposed to cutting the hair which makes for a very painful experience when using it on your face.  Terrible replacement.

reviews.t: Dull. 2 year old OEM Blade cuts better.
reviews.x: After putting on the new blade I found that instead of trimming or cutting it pulled or ripped. I ended up putting back on an old OEM blade that cut 1000x better. Do not waste your money on this product.

reviews.t: Sent opened package taped up and one of the packages with head also opened.
reviews.x: This item came already opened and taped shut!! One of the heads separate packages was also open. I believe this is against federal law and I will be reporting this to the proper authorities also!!
Do not purchase these if you value your face. They don't cut very well. They tank on the hair when it is supposed to glide and cut. Stay away from this product!

reviews.t: Horrible! I wish I read the ratings first! These blades YANK out your whiskers.
reviews.x: Horrible! I wish I read the ratings first! These blades YANK out your whiskers. Unfortunately I bought two packages. They will be going back.
Had no issues with the one blade brand. Thought I'd try a cheaper one and I got what I paid for. These do not cut for anything. They suck!

claims.text: Most reviewers report the blades pull or rip hair instead of cutting it.
Many reviewers say the blades do not fit or lock into the device properly, with some noting the guard cannot be attached.
Several reviewers describe the blades as poor quality compared to the original brand and regret not paying more for the name brand.
Some reviewers report the blades jam or clog with hair quickly and take much longer to complete a shave or trim.
A few reviewers mention skin irritation, nicking, or bleeding during use.
